A provenance manifest is at logos/sources.json. Dark-mode guidance: vector.png (black) and hkust.png (navy) are not readable on dark backgrounds - swap to the *_dark.png variants or place logos on a light chip; zju.png is visible but low contrast (~2.6:1) on dark; uwaterloo (white keyline), ucdavis (gold ring), tencent (blue ~3:1+) and minimax (self-contained gradient tile) are fine. Source notes: no rsvg-convert/inkscape/cairosvg were installed, so Commons SVGs were fetched as Commons server-rendered PNGs and non-Commons SVGs were rasterised with the already-installed playwright Chromium (scripts/svg2png.py); the hkust and zju GitHub avatars are default identicons (unusable); Vector/MiniMax have no Commons files; Zhejiang University's official .ai downloads were saved without PDF compatibility (unrenderable) and its official PNG is only 318 px, so the Wikipedia vector of the same emblem was used; HKUST's logo.ust.hk download site returns HTTP 500. Helper scripts live in /rmeng_data/yubo_data/October/yubo/website_work/scripts/ (commons_search.py, commons_info.py, commons_fetch.py, probe_site.py, svg2png.py, normalize_logo.py, contact_sheet.py, final_sheet.py); raw originals are under logos/raw/<source>/ with triage sheets in logos/raw/probe/.
